items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Then I’m on Buddy’s band in ’66 and I joined the band

ctx.x: Yeah the Four Freshmen, exactly. The Four Freshmen and that. So for AM records and for pop music the Beach Boys were the closest thing to that as far as ‘cause they had voicings and it was real nice rather than just the rock & roll that was of the day. I did enjoy when Motown came out, this was later though. The Motown came out, and I did a lot of Motown and it was great you know. It was funky and it was loose, it was happy and precision didn’t have to be — it wasn’t part of the picture. You know precision —…

Before I leave your childhood I just wondered what it was like to be making some money and going to high school or middle school, wherever you were. Did you stand out as a student like man, he’s playing gigs? © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
